summary: Focused backend regression testing on the two functional changes since iteration_1: (a) GET /api/clients still returns all seeded galleries with correct cover + photo_count after adding .limit(20000) to the photos cursor, and (b) PUT /api/admin/clients/{id}/photos/order now uses bulk_write. Added /app/backend/tests/test_reorder_and_listing.py (7 cases) — all 7 PASSED. Verified: listing returns 7 clients, per-client photo_count matches detail; reorder requires admin (401), rejects foreign photo IDs (400), persists partial-payload ordering (head reversed exactly, unnamed photos trail behind), and PIN 200604 sets admin_session cookie while wrong PIN returns 401. Also re-ran the full pytest suite: 25 passed, 5 failed — the 5 failures are pre-existing tscheck_* files hardcoding an old PIN '1234' (unrelated to this iteration's changes).

minor.issue: Pre-existing test files hardcode admin PIN '1234' and now fail against current ADMIN_PIN=200604 (5 tests). Not caused by current changes; recommend updating those tests to read ADMIN_PIN env or deleting them since /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py + new test_reorder_and_listing.py already cover the same surface.

action_items: (Optional) Update or delete the stale tscheck_* test files that hardcode PIN '1234' — they now fail with 401 against ADMIN_PIN=200604.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_reorder_photos: bulk_write correctness verified — head order matches payload exactly, unnamed photos correctly trail (position = len(payload)+offset). Ownership check on 20k-limited async set-comprehension works as expected.
list_clients: async cursor with .limit(20000) still populates grouped dict correctly for all seeded clients (verified per-client count parity with detail endpoint).
Stale root-level /app/backend_test.py referenced in iteration_1 code review is still worth removing to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded clients. Reorder test picked first client with >=3 photos, permuted head, and restored original order after assertion (best-effort).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New focused suite: /app/backend/tests/test_reorder_and_listing.py. It reads ADMIN_PIN env (default 200604) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Run: `cd /app/backend && ADMIN_PIN=200604 pytest tests/test_reorder_and_listing.py -v`. The tscheck_*.py suite is stale (hardcoded PIN 1234) — its failures are not regressions.
rca of the issue: N/A — all in-scope changes behave correctly.
